recomputed.note: The published 3 pathways were chosen by univariate AUC on the FULL n=105 (selection outside CV). Honest nested selection (re-pick top-3 within each fold) is the leakage-free estimate. Any positive gap = optimism attributable to selection leakage.

claims.note: Selection done on full data outside CV; reported CV/optimism understate true out-of-sample error
claims.corrective_action: Disclose feature selection was performed outside CV; report as optimistic; recommend nested selection.

recomputed.note: T_EFFECTOR has positive univariate association (AUC 0.613) but NEGATIVE multivariate coefficient. This is a classic suppressor/collinearity artifact -> the '3-pathway' model's interpretability claim ('T-effector reflects resistance') is fragile and likely a statistical artifact of small n + correlated features, not a biological finding.

claims.corrective_action: Add caveat: T_EFFECTOR negative multivariate coefficient despite positive univariate AUC => likely collinearity/suppressor artifact, not a resistance mechanism.

claims.recomputed: Internal-validation-only, discovery-stage biomarker (single cohort, small n, selection outside CV, borderline CI).

clinical_utility_framing.intended_use: RESEARCH USE ONLY exploratory biomarker to estimate likelihood of response/benefit to anti-PD-1 monotherapy (nivolumab/pembrolizumab) from pre-treatment bulk tumor RNA-seq. Primary evidence is in metastatic melanoma; cross-cancer use (ovarian) is hypothesis-generating only.
clinical_utility_framing.target_population: Patients with advanced/metastatic melanoma being considered for anti-PD-1 therapy and with available pre-treatment tumor RNA-seq. NOT established for other tumor types, combination IO, or treatment monitoring.
clinical_utility_framing.comparator_standard_of_care: Current clinical practice uses PD-L1 IHC (and TMB/MSI in some settings). In this dataset PD-L1 (CD274) transcript AUC ~0.57; the model's apparent AUC ~0.71 / cross-validated ~0.69. Any 'improvement over PD-L1' is modest, of borderline statistical significance, and not equivalent to clinical superiority vs guideline PD-L1 IHC.
clinical_utility_framing.current_evidence_tier: TIER 3 - internal-validation-only, single primary cohort (n=105, 23 events), feature selection performed outside CV, borderline 95% CI (lower bound ~0.50). Discovery / analytically-exploratory. NOT clinically validated.
prospective_evidence_roadmap_to_true_val: 1. Independent EXTERNAL validation cohort(s) with pre-specified, locked model + threshold (no re-fitting).
2. Pre-registered analysis plan; feature selection frozen before validation.
3. Calibration assessment (calibration curve, Brier score), not just discrimination (AUC).
4. Clinical-utility analysis: decision-curve analysis / net benefit vs PD-L1 IHC standard of care.
5. Adequate events-per-variable (>=10) and sample size justified by a formal power calculation.
6. Head-to-head vs guideline biomarkers (PD-L1 IHC, TMB, MSI) on the SAME external samples.
7. Ultimately a prospective/interventional biomarker-stratified study for true clinical validation + any regulatory (e.g., companion-diagnostic) pathway.
clinical_utility_framing.RUO_statement: This validation increases evidentiary rigor and defensibility; it does NOT constitute clinical validation. No regulatory clearance is implied. Findings are Research Use Only.

disclaimer: Validation = independent reproduction from cited sources / re-run from committed data. It is NOT clinical validation. True clinical validation requires prospective, externally validated, appropriately powered studies with pre-specified thresholds. Everything RUO; no regulatory clearance implied; no data fabricated.
key_finding: PIVOTAL: the package contains TWO divergent models. The MANUSCRIPT_DRAFT (2-pathway EXH+TIL, nested-CV AUC ~0.60) is the honest, current, multicollinearity-corrected model and SUPERSEDES the 3-pathway model in README/tables/STRATEGY (apparent AUC 0.711). VIF reproduced exactly (EXH 21.7, TIL 24.2), confirming why T_EFFECTOR was dropped. The manuscript is already scientifically honest (mandatory external validation, premature-clinical-utility caveats); the main corrective need is reconciling the deprecated 3-pathway artifacts and residual overstatements.
